faq.a: Dastgir is associated with Persian. Persian dastgīr ('helper, protector'; the source gloss 'Authority, Power, Leader' is an approximation). The source record classified it as Arabic, which is incorrect.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Dastgir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
